DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの詰合せに、ご興味がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in this assortment?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。土産の予算が千円なのですが、この大きい袋は千五百円ですね。量を少なくして買えるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 千円予算と千五百円大袋を示し少量の別商品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My souvenir budget is one thousand yen, but this large bag is fifteen hundred yen. Is there a smaller quantity I can buy?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your one-thousand-yen budget and the large bag's fifteen-hundred-yen price, and ask about another product in a smaller quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ詰合せの小袋は八百円です。大袋そのものの値引きはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: A small bag of the same assortment is eight hundred yen. We aren't discounting the large bag itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小袋を見たいです。予算に合わせて大袋の値段を変えていただくより、持ち帰る量を減らします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大袋値引きでなく八百円小袋を見て量を減らすと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to see the small bag. Rather than asking you to change the large bag's price to fit my budget, I'll take a smaller quantity home.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will look at the eight-hundred-yen small bag and reduce the quantity rather than ask for a discount on the large bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが小袋です。中の種類は大袋と同じですが、それぞれの量が少なくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the small bag. It has the same varieties as the large bag, but less of each.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で少しずつ食べる土産なので、この量でよさそうです。大袋より種類が少なくなると思っていたので、説明が助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人少量用と種類は同じで量だけ減る説明への理解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a souvenir for two people to eat a little at a time, so this amount looks good. I thought there would be fewer varieties than in the large bag, so the explanation helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is for two people to eat small amounts and you understand the varieties stay the same while only quantities decrease. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しする相手と、食べる予定に合わせてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose according to who you're giving it to and how you plan to eat it.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰宅後、家族と食べます。友人の家へ配る分もここから分けるつもりでしたが、今回は自宅の分だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配布目的を取りやめ帰宅後家族用だけに絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll eat it with my family after getting home. I had also planned to divide some of this up for friends' households, but this time I'll just get it for home.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Drop the plan to distribute it and limit the purchase to eating with your family after getting home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小袋一つでよろしいですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、八百円の一袋です。残りの二百円を別の品で必ず使い切る必要はないので、これだけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 八百円一袋を確定し残り予算二百円は使い切らず一品購入にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, one bag for eight hundred yen. I don't have to spend the remaining two hundred yen on something else, so just this, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one eight-hundred-yen bag and buy only that item without spending the remaining two-hundred-yen budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 八百円のお会計です。それでは、ご家族でお楽しみください。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will be eight hundred yen. Please enjoy it with your family. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市民講座の参加について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about attending the community classes?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 園芸を始めたいです。ただ、仕事の休みが週ごとに変わるので、毎週同じ曜日の講座には通いにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交代勤務で毎週固定曜日の園芸講座へ通いにくいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to start gardening. But my days off change each week, so it's difficult to attend a class on the same weekday every week.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that changing workdays make it difficult to attend a gardening class on a fixed weekday every week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 継続の講座のほかに、一回だけ参加する入門回もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides the ongoing course, there are also introductory sessions you attend just once.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず入門回へ参加したいです。毎週来ると約束して欠席を重ねるより、自分が参加できる日から始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回入門回を選び継続出席約束より参加可能日から始めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to attend an introductory session first. Rather than promise to come every week and repeatedly miss classes, I'll start with a day I can attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a one-off introductory session and say you want to start on a day you can attend rather than promise ongoing attendance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今月の入門回は、こちらの二日から選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: This month's introductory session can be chosen from these two dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後の土曜日が休みです。まだ職場の予定が変わる可能性もあるので、参加変更の連絡方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 候補後の土曜を選び勤務変更可能性から変更連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm off on the later Saturday. My work schedule could still change, so please tell me how to contact you about changing my attendance.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the later Saturday and ask how to report changes because your work schedule may change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この受付へ、講座名と申込みの番号をお知らせください。変更できる範囲は、その時の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell this reception desk the class name and your application number. Please check the guidance at that time about what changes can be made.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付の番号を控えます。参加できなくなったらそのままにせず、分かった時に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付連絡番号を控え不参加判明時に知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note down the reception contact number. If I can no longer attend, I won't leave it unreported; I'll contact you when I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will note the reception contact number and notify them when you learn you cannot attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入門回では、育てる物を選ぶための簡単な紹介を予定しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: At the introductory session, we plan a brief introduction to help you choose what to grow.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家に小さいベランダがあります。まずそこで育てる物を考えたいので、入門回の内容が合っています。土曜日の一回で申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小ベランダの育成対象選びに合う単発土曜回へ申込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a small balcony at home. I'd first like to consider what to grow there, so the introductory session suits me. I'll register for the one Saturday session.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Register for the one-off Saturday session that fits choosing what to grow on your small balcony. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の回をお受けします。それでは、園芸を始めるよい機会になりますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll accept your registration for that session. We hope it will be a good opportunity to start gardening. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お仕事の記録で、確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check about your work records?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一年の売上は二十万円ありましたが、用意した費用の記録は三十万円です。手元では赤字なので、収入なしと書いてよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年間売上二十万円と費用記録三十万円で赤字なら収入なしと書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: My sales for the year were two hundred thousand yen, but the expense records I've prepared total three hundred thousand yen. My figures show a loss, so I'm unsure whether I may write 'no income.'
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may write no income because annual sales are two hundred thousand yen and expense records are three hundred thousand yen, showing a loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売上が入った事実と、費用の記録は両方お示しください。税務上の扱いは担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show both the fact that sales were received and the expense records. The person in charge will check the tax treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 売上の記録も残します。費用のほうが多かったからと、二十万円を受け取った事実がなくなるわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 費用超過でも二十万円受領の事実を売上記録として残すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll keep the sales records too. Having higher expenses doesn't erase the fact that I received two hundred thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the sales record of receiving two hundred thousand yen despite higher expenses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの内容を、資料と合わせて説明できるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please be ready to explain each item alongside the supporting documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売った日と入金した日をまとめた表があります。費用には備品と材料を入れていますが、どれを認めてもらえるかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売却入金日の表と備品材料の費用内容を示し費用認定は未相談と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a table listing the sale dates and deposit dates. I've included equipment and materials in expenses, but I haven't yet asked which of them will be accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the sale-and-deposit-date table and equipment-and-material expense details, and say expense acceptance has not yet been discussed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 費用の扱いも、その内容を見て確認することになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: How the expenses are treated will also be checked after looking at what they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で三十万円全部が認められたことにせず、領収の資料と使った目的を添えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全費用認定を自己決定せず領収資料と目的を持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't decide on my own that all three hundred thousand yen has been accepted. I'll bring the receipt documents and the purposes of the spending for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will bring receipt documents and spending purposes rather than decide all expenses are accepted yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は記入を確定する前の相談でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is today's consultation before you finalize what you write?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。売上二十万円と費用の記録三十万円を別々に持って、担当の説明を聞きます。収入なしと先に記入するのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未記入段階で二種類資料を担当へ示し収入なしと記入前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll take the two-hundred-thousand-yen sales records and the three-hundred-thousand-yen expense records separately and listen to the explanation. I'll wait before writing 'no income.'
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Before filling it in, show both sets of documents to the person in charge and consult before writing no income. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その二つの資料をそろえて担当へお見せください。それでは、ご相談の席へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please prepare both sets of documents and show them to the person in charge. Please go to the consultation area. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのカウンターへどうぞ。

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 椅子が高くて、座ると足が落ち着きません。低い椅子の席が空いていたら、そちらへ案内していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高いカウンター椅子で足が落ち着かず低い席を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: The chair is high, and my feet don't feel stable when I sit. If a seat with a lower chair is available, could you show me there?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your feet feel unstable on the high counter chair and request a lower seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥のテーブルに空きがあります。お連れ様も一緒に移られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a table available at the back. Will your companion move with you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一緒にお願いします。連れはもう座っていますが、まだ注文はしていません。席を移ると伝えてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未注文の同行者へ席変更を伝え二人で移ると頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Together, please. My companion is already seated, but we haven't ordered yet. I'll go and tell them we're moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to move together after telling your companion, who has not ordered yet, about the seat change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、お二人でこちらへどうぞ。手前の二席をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then both of you, please come this way. Use these two seats at the near end.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 座ってみました。この高さなら落ち着きます。連れも隣に座れたので、ここで注文できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 低い二席で本人と連れが隣に座れ注文可能と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've tried sitting here. This height feels comfortable. My companion could sit next to me too, so we can order here.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you and your companion can sit side by side in the two lower seats and can order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご注文のお品は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided what to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私はしょうゆラーメンを一杯です。連れはみそを一杯と言っています。二人ともここで食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人しょうゆ一杯と同行者みそ一杯を各注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: One soy-sauce ramen for me. My companion says one miso ramen. We'll both eat here.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Order one soy-sauce ramen for yourself and one miso ramen for your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: しょうゆ一杯とみそ一杯ですね。お料理はこちらのテーブルへお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: One soy-sauce and one miso, correct? We'll bring the food to this table.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。最初のカウンターではなく、このテーブルで待ちます。座りにくさを先にお伝えできてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文確認後新テーブルで待ち座りにくさを先に相談できたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We'll wait at this table rather than the original counter. I'm glad I could explain the difficulty sitting beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After confirming the order, say you will wait at the new table and are glad you mentioned the seating difficulty first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の席をご用意できました。それでは、お食事をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We were able to provide the seats you wanted. Please enjoy your meal. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乾杯のお飲み物は、皆様同じビールでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: For the toast, would everyone like the same beer?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私はアルコールの入っていない飲み物にしたいです。同僚と乾杯には参加しますが、自分の一杯を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚のビール一括注文へ本人はアルコールなしを希望し乾杯参加を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a drink without alcohol. I'll join the toast with my coworkers, but I'd like to choose my own drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: When beer is being ordered for all coworkers, request a nonalcoholic drink for yourself and say you will join the toast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内からお選びいただけます。どんな味がお好みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can choose from this list. What kind of flavor do you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 甘くないものが希望です。このお茶をお願いします。乾杯のために、ビールの色に似た飲み物でなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 甘くないお茶を選びビール風外観は不要と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd prefer something not sweet. This tea, please. It doesn't need to look like beer for the toast.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose unsweetened tea and say a beer-like appearance is unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お茶一杯ですね。ほかの皆様の飲物と一緒にお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: One tea, correct? We'll bring it with everyone else's drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。同僚には私はお茶で乾杯すると伝えました。食事に合わせて飲めるよう、熱すぎない温かいお茶でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同僚へお茶で乾杯と共有し食事に合う熱すぎない温かい茶を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I've told my coworkers I'll toast with tea. Please make it warm but not too hot, so I can drink it with the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you told your coworkers you will toast with tea and request warm tea that is not too hot to drink with your meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらがお茶です。ご注文どおりかお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is your tea. Please check that it is what you ordered.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お茶を受け取りました。皆さんの飲み物が来てから一緒に乾杯します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 茶を受領して全員の飲物がそろうまで待ち同時乾杯を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've received the tea. I'll wait for everyone else's drinks and join the toast together.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Receive the tea and choose to wait until everyone's drinks arrive to toast together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お料理のご相談もございましたら、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know if you also need to discuss the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料理は同僚と選んだ内容でお願いします。飲み物だけ自分で選べたので、落ち着いて同じ席で楽しめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲物だけ本人選択で料理は共同で決めた注文を続けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please keep the food order as my coworkers and I chose together. Being able to choose just my own drink means I can relax and enjoy being at the same table.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that only the drink was your individual choice and the shared food order should remain as agreed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、皆様で楽しいお食事を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Have a pleasant meal together. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お食事のお皿をお下げしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I clear your meal plates?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。子どもが椅子で眠ってしまったので、デザートは頼まず帰ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食後に眠った子のため未注文デザートを見送り帰宅希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. My child has fallen asleep in the chair, so we'll go home without ordering dessert.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child fell asleep after the meal and you want to go home without ordering dessert. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだデザートのご注文は受けていませんので、お会計をご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't taken a dessert order yet, so we can prepare your bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。起こして何を食べるか選んでもらうより、今日は食事が済んだところで終えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 起こして甘味選択を迫らず食事終了時点で切り上げると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Rather than waking my child and having them choose what to eat, I'd like to finish for today now that the meal is over.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will finish now that the meal is over rather than wake your child to choose sweets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お荷物をまとめるお時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have time to gather your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。上着を着せて、子どもの小さい鞄を私の袋へ入れます。もう一人の家族に抱いてもらう間、私が支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上着小鞄をまとめ家族の抱っこと本人会計を分担する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll put a jacket on my child and put their small bag inside my bag. I'll pay while another family member holds the child.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Gather the jacket and small bag, and divide the tasks so a family member holds the child while you pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 伝票はこちらです。ご注文のお食事の分をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is your bill. Please check the meals you ordered.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三人分の食事が載っています。まだ頼んでいないデザートは入っていないので、この内容で支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 伝票の三人食事と未注文甘味が不記載を確認して支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: It lists meals for three people. It doesn't include dessert that we haven't ordered, so I'll pay this amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the bill contains three meals and no unordered dessert, and pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計が済みました。入口までお荷物をお持ちになる時は、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your payment is complete. Please let us know when carrying your bags to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族が子どもを抱き、私は荷物を持ちます。二人で分担できたので、このまま帰れます。食事の時間を取れてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族は子本人は荷物を持ち分担帰宅できると礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family member will hold the child and I'll carry the bags. We've shared the tasks, so we can leave as we are. I'm glad we could spend time having a meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank them and say you can go home with a family member holding the child while you carry the bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。それでは、ご家族皆様お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please all take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散策は、お楽しみいただけていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、連れが話をしている間に、竹を見るのを忘れていました。少し立ち止まって見る時間も取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者と話す間に景色を見忘れ観察時間も取りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But while my companion was talking, I forgot to look at the bamboo. I'd also like to take a little time to stop and look.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot to look at the scenery while talking with your companion and want time to observe too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの脇なら、歩く方の流れから外れてご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can step aside here, out of the flow of walkers, to look.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連れに、ここで三分ほど見る時間を取りたいと伝えます。話を聞きたくないのではなく、景色も覚えて帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脇で三分観察を連れへ頼み会話拒否でなく風景を覚えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll tell my companion I want to spend about three minutes looking here. It's not that I don't want to listen; I want to remember the scenery when I go home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask your companion for three minutes to observe from the side and explain you want to remember the scenery, not reject conversation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご一緒に、何か気になる形を探してみてはいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: Why not look together for a shape that catches your interest?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連れにも見てもらいました。まっすぐな所と曲がった所を見つけ、あとでどちらが印象に残ったか話すことにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連れと直曲がる形を探し後で印象を話す計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've had my companion look too. We found straight sections and curved ones and decided to talk later about which left more of an impression.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you plan to find straight and curved shapes with your companion and discuss impressions later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言葉にする前に、ご自身で眺める時間もよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's nice to have time to look for yourself before putting it into words too.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は少し静かに見ています。写真を何枚も撮るより、一つの形をゆっくり覚えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真量より静かに一形状を観察して記憶したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm looking quietly for a little while now. Rather than taking lots of photos, I want to take my time remembering one shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to quietly observe and remember one shape rather than take many photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この後の散策も、ご自身のペースでお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please continue the rest of your walk at your own pace too.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見る時間を取れました。これから歩きながら、連れと見つけた形の話をします。話と観察をどちらも楽しめそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察終了後歩きながら見つけた形を連れと共有すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was able to take time to look. Now we'll talk about the shapes we found while walking. It seems we can enjoy both conversation and observing.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the shapes you found with your companion while walking after observing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお二人でお楽しみください。それでは、よい散策を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy it together. Have a pleasant walk. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 忍者の衣装で、お写真を撮られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a photo in a ninja costume?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。眼鏡を使っているので、顔を覆う布が重なると前が見にくくなりました。写真を撮る前に調整できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眼鏡と忍者顔布が重なり見にくいため写真前の調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wear glasses, and when the cloth covering my face overlaps them, it becomes hard to see ahead. Could we adjust it before taking the photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to adjust the ninja face cloth before the photo because overlapping your glasses makes it hard to see. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、目のまわりを空けた着方でお撮りいただけます。係と一緒に位置を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here you can take the photo with the area around your eyes uncovered. Let's check the position with a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 眼鏡は使ったままでお願いします。目の位置が空けば、写真へ向く場所も自分で見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 眼鏡を残し目元が空く着方を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to keep my glasses on. If the area around my eyes is clear, I can see where to face for the photo myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to keep your glasses and wear the cloth so the eye area is clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 布の位置を合わせました。鏡でご覧になれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: We've adjusted the cloth. Can you see in the mirror?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見えます。前より顔が分かる形ですが、この着方で写真を残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鏡で見え方と顔の露出を確認しその着方で記念を残すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. More of my face is visible than before, but I'd like to keep a photo with the costume worn this way.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check your view and face exposure in the mirror and choose to keep a photo wearing it that way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ポーズは、立つ形と座る形から選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose a standing or sitting pose.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座る形にします。布がひざへ重なる所を整えてから、椅子のどこへ座ればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座る姿勢を選びひざに重なる布を整えて椅子の座る位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll sit. After arranging the cloth that overlaps my knees, please tell me where on the chair to sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose sitting, arrange the cloth over your knees, and ask where to sit on the chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへお座りください。一枚撮って、仕上がりをご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please sit here. We'll take one photo and you can check the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕上がりを見ました。目元と眼鏡が見えて、自分らしい一枚になりました。この写真をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕上がりの目元眼鏡を確認し本人らしい一枚を採用する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've looked at the result. My eyes and glasses show, and it feels like a photo of me as myself. I'd like this photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the eyes and glasses in the result and choose the photo that feels like you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、衣装の返却をご案内します。楽しい思い出になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We'll guide you through returning the costume. We hope it makes a happy memory.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと少し遊ぶ前に、水筒へ水を入れたいです。飲む水を入れられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 親子短時間遊び前に持参水筒へ飲用水を補充できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to fill my water bottle before playing with my child for a little while. Is there somewhere I can fill it with drinking water?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to refill your own bottle with drinking water before a short playtime with your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの水飲み場には、水筒用の蛇口があります。持参の水筒はお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: This drinking fountain has a tap for water bottles. You have your own bottle with you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、空の水筒があります。子どもにも場所を見せてから入れ、遊んだ後にも同じ所へ戻れるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空水筒を示し子にも位置を見せ再訪できるようにしたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have an empty bottle. I'd like to show my child the location before filling it, so we can come back to the same place after playing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the empty bottle and say you want your child to see the location so you can return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場の右側から行けます。水筒用の表示をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can get there from the right side of the square. Please check the sign for water bottles.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示を見つけました。水筒へ入れて、ふたも閉まりました。子どもの小さい鞄に入れると自分で持てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水筒用表示を確認して給水閉栓を終え子自身の鞄へ収める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've found the sign. I've filled the bottle and closed the lid. If I put it in my child's small bag, they can carry it themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the bottle-filling sign, finish filling and closing the bottle, and put it in your child's own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この後は、どの辺りで過ごされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Where will you spend time after this?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場で二十分だけ遊びます。家へ帰る時間を子どもと先に決めたので、最後に水を飲んで帰るつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 広場二十分と子と合意した帰宅時刻を説明し終了時飲水を予定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll play in the square for just twenty minutes. My child and I already agreed on a time to go home, so we plan to have a drink of water at the end and leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the twenty-minute playtime in the square and the going-home time agreed with your child, with a drink planned at the end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰る前に少し休むなら、広場の端のベンチも使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you want a short rest before leaving, you can also use the benches at the edge of the square.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水を入れる所と休む所が分かりました。今日は長く回るのでなく、近くで遊んでベンチで休み、決めた時刻に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 給水休憩場所を把握し近場遊びベンチ休憩後に予定時刻帰宅を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Now I know where to fill the water and where to rest. Rather than spending a long time going around today, we'll play nearby, rest on a bench, and go home at the agreed time.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you know the water and rest locations and choose nearby play, a bench rest, and going home on time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ親子で楽しい時間を。それでは、お気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a lovely time together. Take care. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 館内のご案内で、分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything unclear about the facility guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 眼鏡を外すと小さい字が見えません。脱衣所へ入る前に、お風呂と帰りの場所を一度教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 脱眼鏡後の小字読解困難を伝え先に浴場と帰路案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Without my glasses, I can't see small print. Before I enter the changing room, could you show me the bath area and the way back once?
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that small print is hard to read after taking off your glasses and ask for bath and return-route guidance beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図を近くでご覧いただけます。脱衣所から浴場へは、この入口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can look at this map up close. This is the entrance from the changing room to the bath.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の印が分かりました。戻る時も同じ所を通るのですね。眼鏡は自分のケースへ入れてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図の入口と同一帰路を確認し眼鏡は本人ケースへ収納すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the entrance marker. We come back the same way, right? I'll put my glasses away in my own case.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the map entrance and same return route, and say you will put your glasses in your own case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 浴場の前には、大きい色の表示もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are also large colored signs in front of the bath area.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 文字だけではなく、青い印を目印にできます。今のうちに、ケースを置く場所も自分で覚えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きい青表示を目印にしケース収納位置も事前に覚えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can use the blue marker as a landmark rather than just the writing. I'd also like to remember where I put the case myself while I still can.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the large blue sign as a landmark and say you also want to remember the case's storage location beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身のロッカーに、お持ち物をまとめていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can keep your belongings together in your own locker.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ロッカーの番号を、眼鏡をかけたまま確認します。番号を見たらケースもその中へ入れるので、戻った時に取り出せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 装眼鏡中にロッカー番号を確認し同場所へケースを収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the locker number with my glasses still on. After seeing the number, I'll put the case inside too, so I can take it out when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the locker number while wearing your glasses and store the case in the same place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からなくなった時は、近くの係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you get unsure, please ask a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内のおかげで、先に入口とロッカーを確かめられます。見えにくくなってから全部を覚えようとして慌てずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口収納位置を先に把握でき脱眼鏡後の慌てを防げると礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thanks to your guidance, I can check the entrance and locker beforehand. I won't have to rush to try to remember everything after it becomes harder to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank them for letting you check the entrance and storage location beforehand to avoid confusion after removing your glasses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不明な点はいつでもお知らせください。それでは、ゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-026-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask anytime anything is unclear. Enjoy your time here. Excuse me.
